messages.content: Return only JSON matching the supplied schema. Design a conceptual programming-language/runtime allocation for a sovereign multi-chain EVM Union under these source-frozen facts. Each enterprise is a sovereign settlement with local law, private state, border services, contracts, books and refusal. The Union will operate EVM-compatible chains and smart accounts and values public standards. Relation Model Notation (RMN) is an existing JSON s-expression IR for portable pure structure-to-structure morphism bodies: typed CHL core, immutable terms, canonical JSON bridge, deterministic evaluation, totality pressure, Lean-certified Church-Rosser core, explicit bounded domain operations, serializable runTerm bodies, and a distinction between pure morphisms and effectful host boundaries. RMN is not a general JavaScript replacement and does not itself perform I/O, arbitrary storage, network calls, wallet effects or prove all domain extensions. Existing theory says an action is not an endpoint; endpoints are projections of one relation model. WMAP projects agency across the web via ActivityPub; WitnessJournal carries RMN terms through time as EAVT rows. ActivityPub provides asynchronous C2S/S2S actors, inboxes/outboxes, rich message delivery and negotiation, while EVM provides consensus-executed authorization, scarce-state transition, programmable commitment, custody and settlement. Node/TypeScript is ubiquitous and suited to web/API/orchestration surfaces; Rust suits memory-safe high-performance runtimes, chain clients, cryptography, proof verification and compilers; Lisp/Racket suits language-oriented programming, macros and humane RMN authoring; Lean suits theorem statements and mechanized proofs; Solidity/Yul target EVM execution. The Leader explicitly rejects rewriting everything into Solidity and wants public standard services separately hireable, including Web Services Section > ActivityPub Services Section. Produce a decisive allocation: define the node's faces, state the exact role of RMN in smart contracts, decide ActivityPub versus EVM, allocate languages by responsibility, define compilation/conformance relations, and list category errors. Do not propose schedules or vendors.
